title: csLagExplainer
description: It explains the possible causes of lag; it has 15+ likely translatable causes.
body:
csLagExplainer is a lightweight Paper plugin that explains server lag in a clear and understandable way.

🔍 Features:
• Shows TPS, MSPT, ping, entities and more
• Explains possible lag causes (configurable)
• Fully configurable & translatable messages
• Permissions support
• Reload command
• Designed for Paper and forks

🎯 Perfect for admins who want to understand WHY lag happens, not just see numbers.
